MedProInstallChrome.categoryNote: The software every MedPro workstation gets. Sources come from MedProUtil_Software.xlsx.
MedProInstallChrome.description: Google Chrome, enterprise MSI. Installs machine-wide for every user on the PC.

MedProInstallOffice.description: Microsoft 365 Apps via the Click-to-Run bootstrapper. This installer does NOT run silently - it shows Microsoft's own installer UI and a technician has to stay at the machine. To make it unattended, switch this entry to the Office Deployment Tool with a MedPro configuration XML.

MedProInstallTeams.description: New Teams, provisioned machine-wide with teamsbootstrapper.exe -p so every user profile gets it. Microsoft's supported deployment method; it fetches the current version itself, so this link does not go stale.

MedProInstallRingCentral.description: RingCentral desktop app for MedPro phone and messaging. Large download, around 415 MB.

MedProInstallRicohPrinters.description: All MedPro Ricoh printer drivers and queues, from \\med-dc-01\Install. Around 284 MB, copied locally before running. Needs network access to the share.

MedProInstallKaseyaAgent.description: Kaseya VSA management agent for MedPro workstations, from \\med-dc-01\Install. Install this on every machine - it is how IT manages the PC afterwards.

MedProInstall7Zip.categoryNote: Not part of the standard build. These are for MedPro IT machines and are only selected by the IT technician preset.
MedProInstall7Zip.description: Archive tool. The direct link is version-pinned, so it falls back to winget once 7-Zip publishes a newer build.

MedProInstallNotepadPlusPlus.description: Text editor for logs, CSVs, and config files.
